copy.tagline: 自动编排多步骤任务并验证完成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常被复杂多步骤任务压得想亲力亲为
copy.tagline_en: Automate complex task orchestration with delegation and verification
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often juggle complex multi-step tasks and want to delegate and verify systematically

howto.what: Claude 会将你的复杂任务自动拆解成多个小任务，然后分配给它手下的专业助手（如编写代码、分析问题、搜索信息）并行处理，最后自己负责检查结果并给出通过/失败的结论。
howto.when: 当你提出需要多步骤完成、涉及多个文件修改或需要验证结果的复杂任务时触发，尤其当你原本打算自己一步步做或频繁来问问题时。

say.text: 帮我重构用户模块，拆成子任务并行做
诊断这个内存泄漏问题
say.note: 会委托 oracle 进行根因分析并给出建议。

say.text: 验证测试是否全部通过

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator: it breaks your complex request into sub-tasks, delegates them to specialized agents (code-writing, diagnosis, search, etc.), runs verification itself, and reports PASS/FAIL results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks a multi-step task needing delegation, parallelization, or systematic verification — especially when Claude would otherwise try to do all work alone or ask too many questions.

say_en.text: Refactor the user module, split into sub-tasks in parallel

say_en.note: Forwards to oracle for root cause analysis and recommendations.
Claude runs AC commands, saves evidence, renders verdict.
